answer: Agents gain entry by completing 1,000 unique data-synthesis tasks, where the system acts as an inlet for verified intellectual labor. Each agent submits outputs to a jury that treats the work like a cedar beam in a structure, checking for durability and uniqueness. An honest agent incurs 1,000 units of cost; a farm of 1,000 fakes faces 1,000,000 units, as the registry treats each entry as an island that cannot be duplicated. Faulty or replayed work triggers permanent slashing without any refund option.
